Jared Goff will be traded to the Lions on the first day of the 2021 league year. We are processing the trade early due to multiple requests, however he will not be a member of the Lions roster nor impact their salary cap until March 18, 2021. He will be officially carried on the Rams salary cap at $34.95 million until March 17. Jared Goff signed a 4 year extension with the Los Angeles Rams on September 6, 2019.  The extension is worth $134 million in new money over 4 years.  We are estimating Goff to receive $57,042,682 fully guaranteed at signing.  The full guarantee consists of a $25 million signing bonus, guaranteed salaries in 2019 & 2020, and a practical (guaranteed ~three days after signing) $21 million roster bonus in 2020.  Goff has injury guarantees in salary in 2021 of $25 million and $10 million in 2022.  The $25 million injury guarantee in 2021 will vest into a full guarantee (likely in 2020, but date is unknown).  Goff has yearly roster bonuses due in 2022-2024. Goff converted $9 million of salary into a signing bonus in 2020. The move freed up $7.2 million in cap room for the Rams. Goff\'s cap number for each of the remaining seasons under contract will increase by $1.8 million. Following a trade to the Lions, the Lions converted $20 million of Goff\'s 2021 salary into a signing bonus. The move creates $15 million in 2021 cap room for the Lions and increases Goff\'s cap charge by $5 million in each of the remaining seasons of his contract.

Matthew Stafford signed a one year, $55 million contract extension with the Rams on May 21, 2026. Stafford has $90 million in guarantees and $50 million of the $55 million new money is fully guaranteed at signing. Stafford's 2026 and 2027 salaries are fully guaranteed at signing. There is a fully guaranteed $5 million roster bonus due on the 5th day of the 2027 league year. There is a $5 million roster bonus due on the 3rd day of the 2028 league year that will become fully guaranteed if on the roster on the 3rd day of the 2027 league year. There is no offset to the roster bonus if Stafford is released. There are multiple option bonuses in the contract, $24 million in options in 2026 and $35 million in options in 2027. These options are all due by the start of the regular season. The team can opt to decline the options in increments of $6 million per option in 2026 and $8.75 million per option in 2027 to determine how they want to manage their cap charges. Each declined option would increase Stafford's base salary by the corresponding amount if the Rams choose to do that. Stafford's 2026 cap number should remain unchanged and the Rams will only pay $2 million more on the 2027 salary cap to have Stafford on the roster rather than letting his contract expire.

On June 11, 2026, the Kansas City Chiefs and Patrick Mahomes agreed to a new contract. The contract is 8 years in length with 2 new years added. We are valuing the contract at $64 million APY.  Preliminary contract details courtesy of Albert Breer of SI . Mahomes has $182.8 million guaranteed for injury with $95.5 million fully guaranteed at signing. Mahomes\'s money does not change for 2026. Starting in 2027, Mahomes has yearly $30 million roster bonuses due to be earned on May 5th of each year, along with a $1 million offseason workout bonus. Mahomes\'s salary and bonuses for 2027 are effectively guaranteed with a portion of 2028 effectively guaranteed after signing. Starting in March of 2028, on the third day of each league year, the following year\'s roster bonus becomes guaranteed (a year early) with the base salary and workout bonuses becoming guaranteed in March of the same year. For example, in March 2028, the 2029 Roster Bonus becomes guaranteed along with the 2028 base salary and workout bonus. In March 2029, the 2030 Roster bonus becomes guaranteed, along with the remaining 2029 base salary and workout bonus. The same actions occur in 2031 and 2032. For 2033, the Roster Bonus, base salary, and workout bonus all vest to full guarantees in the same 2033 year, all on the first day of the league year. Mahomes can earn an additional $17.5 million via incentives for 2027 through 2033. $1.25 million for each Super Bowl win (with 50% playtime) and $1.25 million AP MVP for reaching the AFC Championship. Mahomes also has a no trade clause as part of the contract. Previous Contract: Patrick Mahomes signed a 10 year, $450 million contract extension with the Chiefs on July 6, 2020. The contract has $63.0819 million fully guaranteed at signing including a $10 million signing bonus. $141 million is guaranteed for injury and a total of $477.631 million can become guaranteed based on roster status. On the 3rd day of the 2021 league year Mahomes\\\' 2023 salary and bonuses will become fully guaranteed. On the 3rd day of the 2022 league year all of Mahomes 2024 compensation will become fully guaranteed. On the 3rd day of the 2023 league year Mahomes $38.9 million 2025 roster bonus will become guaranteed. On the 3rd day of the 2o24 league year the rest of Mahomes\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\' 2025 salary will become guaranteed. On the 3rd day of the 2025 league year Mahomes $38.9 million 2026 roster bonus will be fully guaranteed. On the 3rd day of the 2026 league year the rest of Mahomes 2026 salary and his $49.4 million 2027 roster bonus become guaranteed. On the 3rd day of the 2027 league year the rest of Mahomes\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\' 2027 salary and his entire 2028 salary and bonuses will become fully guaranteed. On the 3rd day of the 2028 league year Mahomes salary and bonuses in 2029 are guaranteed. On the 3rd day of the 2029 league year Mahomes\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\' 2030 salary and bonuses are guaranteed. On the 3rd day of the 2030 league year Mahomes $13.9 million 2031 roster bonus is guaranteed. Finally on the 3rd day of the 2031 league year the rest of his salary is guaranteed. The Chiefs converted Mahomes\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\' $21.716 million roster bonus into a signing bonus on March 11, 2021. The move created $17.374 million in cap space for the Chiefs in 2021. Mahomes\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\' cap number will increase by $4.343 million in each of the next four years of the contract. Mahomes signed a revised contract in September of 2023 that moved cash forward from later years, effectively giving him a raise of $48.3 million from 2023-26. The reworked deal also added two void years in 2032 and 2033 and changed his incentives to escalators to help create roughly $2.5 million in 2023 cap space. Mahomes converted a $47.745 million in salary to a bonus for cap purposes in 2025. The move lowered Mahomes\\\\\\\' 2025 salary cap number by $38.196 million and increased his future cap numbers by $9.549 million in each season from 2026 through 2029. In 2026, Mahomes converted $54.45 million of salary to a bonus for salary cap purposes. The move opened up $43.56 million in cap room for the Chiefs. His cap number in future years will increase by $10.89 million per year.
